@deskDevServersNote.description: Under the Servers picker of Settings > Linked devices: how many may be chosen.

@deskDevServersCancel.description: Button on the waiting row of a server change this computer proposed: withdraws it.

deskDevServersDown: {down} of {n} not responding. Updates go through the other.

@deskDevServersDown.description: Line under the Servers picker when one of two chosen servers does not answer.

deskDevServersAllDown: No server answers. Updates wait and go when one is back.

@deskDevServersAllDown.description: Line under the Servers picker when no chosen server answers.

deskDevServersInfo1: Linked devices send each other updates through these servers. Every update goes to all chosen servers, so one server down changes nothing.

@deskDevServersInfo1.description: Info card of the Servers row, paragraph 1.

deskDevServersInfo2: A change here is sent to the other devices first; it takes effect once every device has accepted it. The previous servers stay in use until then, and are still read for 7 days after.

@deskDevServersInfo2.description: Info card of the Servers row, paragraph 2.

deskDevServersInfo3: The servers see that two devices exchange updates and when, and, without Tor, from which addresses; never what is in them. Two servers mean two operators see that.

@deskDevServersInfo3.description: Info card of the Servers row, paragraph 3.

@deskDevPausedOffline.description: Under the Pause sync switch while the app is in Offline mode.

@deskDevPausedEpicboxOff.description: Under the Pause sync switch while Epicbox is switched off.

@deskDevHeldAmount.description: Title of a held payment row in Settings > Linked devices. {amount} is the number.

@deskDevHeldNone.description: Held coins list when no other device holds any coin here.

@deskDevRenameThis.description: Title of the dialog that renames this computer.

@deskDevRenameDevice.description: Title of the dialog that renames another linked device.

deskDevPasteLead: Paste the code the other device shows.

@deskDevPasteLead.description: Link dialog, Paste code tab: what to paste.

@deskDevMakingCode.description: Link dialog while the code is made.

@deskDevConnecting.description: Link dialog while this computer answers a pasted code.

@deskDevTheOther.description: The other device in the link dialog when it has not told its name yet.

@deskDevServersLine.description: Link dialog, under the code: the servers the link uses.

deskDevOfferReceived: Is this your other device? Link it to see who sent it and to keep both in step.

@deskDevOfferReceived.description: Quiet line at the end of the details of a payment received by another wallet.
